claims.detail: Simulator critic claim: mutually exclusive hosting mandates must be surfaced as an explicit deadlock pending waiver—not smoothed over in prose.

findings.description: Executive summaries cannot green-light migrations while mandatory serverless clauses collide with mandatory dedicated VM licensing riders in the same RFP revision.
findings.recommendation: Schedule sponsor arbitration that documents which clause yields via formal waiver before rerunning topology automation.

findings.description: Declared elastic tiers contradict illustrated pinned-core VMs until editors collapse the narrative into one permitted footprint.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate diagrams after the waiver pins hosting to either dedicated fleets or consumption-only endpoints.
